thread:
marta: Heads-up: we've updated the "Whistleblower & Reporting" section in the handbook and launched a short 8-minute mandatory attestation for all employees. Please complete by EOD next Thursday. Link: https://handbook.redwood.company/whistleblower-reporting 

marta: The update clarifies anonymous reporting options (third-party hotline), retention of investigation notes, and manager responsibilities for intake. The attestation confirms you've read the policy and know how to submit a report. :information_source: 

kevin: Quick q: does this apply to contractors?

marta: Contractors with Redwood accounts get the assignment. External consultants without accounts are not auto-assigned; if you need them included, request a temporary training account via people-ops.

yasmin: For managers: do we need to confirm we've reviewed our team's understanding of the process?

marta: Yes  managers will have an extra checkbox in the attestation UI to confirm they've discussed intake steps with direct reports. That will be a separate boolean in the CSV export.

julia: Will completion show up on the HR tracker? I need to pull numbers for compliance reporting.

marta: Yes  tracker will record completions and attestation flags. We'll publish a CSV export with columns: employee_email, manager_email, region, completed_at, attestation_signed, manager_confirmation, exemption_note.

harry: Is there an exemption/opt-out for folks who did an external code-of-conduct course recently?

marta: If you completed an equivalent course in the last 45 days, email people-ops@redwood.com with proof and we'll consider exemption. Subject: "Whistleblower Exemption - [Name]".

kevin: Any region-specific language (e.g., EU privacy rules) we should be aware of in the attestation flow?

marta: Yes  regional legal notes added. The handbook clarifies how reports are handled under local law; where local law requires different handling, that prevails. We also added a short FAQ for managers in EMEA.

ops-bot: Automated assignment: 198 users assigned to "Whistleblower & Reporting min attestation". Due: 2025-10-20. Tracker URL: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (snapshot 2025-09-22 14:05 UTC) :bell: 

yasmin: Missed deadline escalation?

marta: Reminders at 7 days, 3 days, and 48 hours. Missed > 10 days = manager follow-up and a soft flag in the HR dashboard. Repeated misses will be reviewed by HRBP. No immediate disciplinary action for a single missed micro-attestation.

julia: For the CSV can we also add a column for "reported_anonymously"? want to track if the hotline is being used (boolean).

marta: Added `reported_anonymously` and `hotline_contacted_at` columns. Note: we will only surface aggregated counts in public dashboards; individual report details remain confidential and are not in the CSV.

harry: Can managers export a per-team CSV or only org-level?

marta: Managers can export their team's completions from the tracker UI. People-ops will also drop a full org CSV to #people-ops-managers on Monday.

yasmin: Thanks  will add a blurb to the manager digest. Any suggested copy?

marta: Suggested blurb: "Updated whistleblower policy + mandatory 8-min attestation. Managers: confirm you've reviewed intake steps with your team. Completion tracked via training tracker; deadline 2025-10-20."

kevin: Thanks. Ping if you want me to run the export and anonymize counts for the compliance deck.

marta: Appreciate it  will ping after the Monday snapshot. Thanks everyone! :handshake:
